introduction.purpose: This document specifies the functional and non-functional requirements for the Project Management Application, providing a complete specification for development, testing, and implementation.

product_scope.summary: A web-based project management solution for small teams featuring task management, automated reminders, role-based access control, and document export capabilities in JSON and PDF formats.
business_objectives: Provide an intuitive project management platform for teams of 2-20 members
Enable efficient project tracking with automated reminder systems
Implement secure role-based access control for team collaboration
Support comprehensive project documentation through export functionality
benefits: Improved team productivity through centralized project management
Reduced administrative overhead with automated reminders
Enhanced security through granular access controls
Streamlined documentation with standardized export formats
goals: Deliver a production-ready project management application within 6 months
Support concurrent access for up to 50 team members
Maintain sub-2-second response times for critical operations

product_perspective.system_context: The application operates as a web-based service accessible through modern browsers, with a RESTful API backend, persistent data storage, and integration capabilities for external systems. The system processes project data, manages user permissions, generates reminders, and produces exportable artifacts.
